Recent work focuses on selective write/read policies, summarization and compression, role- or agent-specific memory, provenance and consistency across agents, and learned retrieval or reflection mechanisms, but robust solutions remain limited by context fragmentation, stale or conflicting memories, error propagation, privacy/security concerns, and the lack of standardized benchmarks for memory quality and coordination effectiveness.
